{{Quote|Yeah, well, a lot of spying goes on. And Bothawui is one of the more active hubs for operatives from around the galaxy. The Empire has its own spies here; so does the Alliance, and they've all pretty much decided to let the place be neutral territory.|[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Bothawui''' ({{Audio|Bothawui-Timeline5.flac|pronunciation}}) was a cosmopolitan [[Planet/Legends|planet]], located in the center of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] race as well as a major hub for information trafficking. It was also the center of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], widely agreed upon to be the best network of information gathering in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] name for the planet was '''Bothawui Proper'''.

==Description==
===Astrography===
Bothawui was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Both]] in the [[Both system]]<ref name="SOTEPG" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was also within the region known as the [[The Slice/Legends|Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was situated at the junction of four major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]],<ref name="SOTEPG" /> including the [[Bothan Run/Legends|Bothan Run]], the [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]], the [[Reena Trade Route]], and the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> Due to a slight wobble in its axial plain, Bothawui experienced numerous small ice ages, which expanded and retracted across the planet's higher latitudes in seventy-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] cycles. Bothawui was also affected by the destruction of the third planet in its system.<ref name="SOTEPG" />
===Planetology===
[[File:Bothawui_worldmap.jpg|left|thumb|A world map of Bothawui]]
A terrestrial world [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], Bothawui had a day that lasted 27 standard hours and a year that consisted of 351 local days.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> The planet was 9,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter<ref name="TEA" /> and possessed a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a temperate climate, and a moderate hydrosphere. Bothawui was a bright blue-green in [[Color/Legends|color]] and its terrain included urban areas, rich equatorial forests, large polar [[Water/Legends|ice]] caps, many rugged mountain ranges, and [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] savannas that spanned the areas between rocky glacier fields.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> 

Due to the presence of mountainous terrain, large tracts of wilderness on Bothawui remained undeveloped and devoid of settlements. Snow covered mountain tops on Bothawui, and as a result of cyclical ice ages, large areas of land on the world would be covered by ice sheets for decades, transforming savannas into rocky wastelands.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Bothawui's mountains and ridges were separated by deep, wide valleys that were inhabited by dangerous wildlife.<ref name="SECRB">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> [[Krak'jya]]s dominated Bothawui's animal life, [[skar'kla]]s were native to the world's higher elevations, and [[ganjuko]]s lived throughout the ice sheets of Bothawui's arctic wastelands. A native fish was the [[salar]], sometimes exported off-world.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Bothawui's geology was the source of the valued [[glitterstone]] [[gemstone/Legends|gem]], and the rare [[serranite/Legends|serranite]] [[mineral/Legends|mineral]].<ref name="SOTEPG" />

==Government and politics==
Bothawui was governed by the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]], in which 18 council members represented the nation states of Bothawui.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> The Bothan Council was based on Bothawui along with various ministries that regulated commerce and government in Bothawui's colonies.<ref name="SESB" /> The council members assigned other clan leaders to fill posts around the ministries and governmental positions, according to their alliances or past supports; in turn those officials appoint other chiefs to lower positions. This nepotistic model formed a robust pyramid scheme, that both supported the Council and ruling clans, and allowed any poor family to grow in status.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Bothawui was the capital of the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]], from where the commerce and government of the system and Bothan colonies were regulated.<ref name="SOTEPG" /><ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> 

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] kept minimal involvement to the Bothawui's economic affairs; thanks to the planet's corporate significance, and the local assets that generated revenues for them, the Galactic Empire didn't wish to subjugate the planet and subvert the economic spirit. Furthermore, the Empire considered the Bothans's contribution to espionage. Nominally, the planet was ruled by a moderate [[Consul-General]] with token military presence.<ref name="SOTEPG" /><ref name="SESB" />

Its high-technology industry made Bothawui an economic hub,<ref name="SESB" /><ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and possessed a reputation as a neutral ground for trade arrangements, diplomatic negotiations, and information-gathering operations.<ref name="SESB" /> Each year the world attracted delegations, economic ministers and other VIPs.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

===Laws===
The Bothan Council took advantage of the planet's astrographic location as a trade route hub; they imposed low tax rates, and minimal bureaucratic regulations to beings and entities that wished to open a business or get a professional license. The process included only a fee, a simple datawork and minimal background and authenticity checks, as the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] of its ministry did not bother with them. As a result, a new business could open in less than a week. Annual operating taxes on Bothawui (which covered rent, utilities and permits) were very low, ranging from 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for small businesses to more than 250,000 credits for large manufacturing facilities; salaries and other costs were also reasonable.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Offworlders were not allowed to buy and own land on the Bothawui. However the simple laws and low prices accomodated businessbeings and other enterpreneurs who worked on the planet.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Strict policies controlled the use and ownership of weapons: the [[Ministry of Tourism]] could register non-lethal weapons and devices for personal protection; lethal weapons or explosive ordinance could be carried only by [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], and even they needed special, expensive (3,000 credits) permits issued by the Bothan Council, following a 3-week processing period and background investigation.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> While espionage was a normal part of Bothawui's life (albeit under the surface), [[lightfight]]s between spies, sabotage and armed infiltrations were discouraged.<ref name="SESB" />

===Economy===
[[File:BothawuiCity.jpg|thumb|left|A city on Bothawui.]]
Thanks to the planet's location, as well as the Bothan Council's policies of simplifying bureaucracy and taxation, Bothawui became a major trade world. A safe hub for passing convoys, it was the center of the trade of technology in its [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and the home of many trade houses and megacorporations while also boasting strong shipping, communication, and transportation industries.<ref name="SOTEPG" /><ref name="SESB" />

Many entities and services, [[bank/Legends|banks]] and markets, enjoyed the simplicity of opening and maintaining offices on the planet. Even semi-legal front companies, enterpreneurs and professional spies were able to obtain a business license and lose themselves in the corporate ecosystem; occasionally closing their "business" the next day and disappear.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

The industrial center and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], which was only a few [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away from Bothawui, supported Bothawui's technology trade.<ref name="SESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 
===Role in galactic espionage===
Centuries of clan competition and political infighting made espionage an acceptable and inseparable element of politics. Assassinations, espionage, and sabotage were as commonplace on Bothawui as debates and typical legislation were on other worlds, and the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] developed into the foremost information-gathering network in the galaxy because of the suspicious and treacherous nature of life on Bothawui.<ref name="SECRB" /> Espionage represented an unofficial industry on Bothawui; the Bothan Spynet, or makeshift networks, sold information to spies from industries, governments, trade organizations, and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] who traveled to collect intelligence for their employers. Taking advantage of the simplicity of establishing a front company, agents and spies of various interests could easily be lost among the corporate levels of manufacturing, commerce, shipping, and service organizations or trade unions. Many [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agents, Rebels, or criminals, visited the planet disguised among the VIPs, complete with an entourage of saboteurs, slicers or assassins. Because of the Bothans's usefulness, the Empire tolerated the spy ecosystem on Bothawui; Rebels and Imperials spied on each other while Bothans spied on everyone and sold information to the highest bidder.<ref name="SOTEPG" /><ref name="SESB" />

Bothawui possessed a peculiar spy culture that obeyed the [[Bothan Way]]; spies, agents and impostors were almost always exposed, but this rarely involved direct violence--and if so, discreetly, covered as "unexplained accidents". Mostly however, when a spy was discovered, the rivals used it in their advantage, either by misleading them with false information, or by following them to identify the spy's contacts and employers.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

==Defenses==
Bothawui lacked an independent navy; the actual home fleet had only a few small [[capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[BTL_Y-wing_starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. Bothans also relied to the guest [[Megacorporation/Legends|mergacorporations]] and the Galactic Empire to protect their interests by protecting the planet itself. Business entities were encouraged to maintain a (regulated) security force in the system, such as [[cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]], rewarded with tax breaks. These private forces were regulated by the Bothan Council, but also surrendered their control to it in cases of emergency.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

Additionally, the planet possessed advanced [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]], whose defense grid had numerous backup systems and redundancies for security. 

Planetside, Bothans had a large, well-equipped and up-to-date civil defense army.<ref name="SOTEPG" />
==History==
===Early history===
Bothan civilization originated in the equatorial forests of Bothawui.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> Bothawui was absorbed into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime during the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], and [[Pers'lya]], a native of Bothawui, became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of the Republic by [[11,987 BBY]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Bothawui was later attacked by forces from [[Masterra|Ord Masterra]] during the [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]] in [[11,198 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" /> A longtime member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]],<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> in which it achieved considerable influence, Bothawui became one of the most recognizable and heavily-trafficked planets in the Galactic Republic, and many bureaucratic committees of the Republic met on Bothawui to discuss governmental matters. Information regarding the expansion of the known galaxy flowed through Bothawui as the Bothans sent agents to join the populations of newly-discovered worlds.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

===Old Sith Wars===
{{Quote|The Republic fleet obliterated the Imperial squadron, and the Battle of Bothawui became the Republic's first major victory in the war.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=BattleOfBothawui-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="timeline5" />}}
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] and fought a battle on the planet, from which they moved to [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]] and [[Manda/Legends|Manda]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:FirstBattleofBothawui-GGW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[First Battle of Bothawui]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] saw the destruction of a Sith Imperial fleet.]]
During the turbulent time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the galaxy faced a deadly threat in the form of the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] which began conquering system after system. In [[3671 BBY]], after a string of victories in the Outer Rim, the Sith turned their attentions to the Both system with the intention of conquering it. This culminated in the [[First Battle of Bothawui]], when a squadron of Imperial warships attempted to conquer the planet, but they were ambushed by Republic forces, who achieved their first victory in the Great Galactic War.<ref name="timeline5" />

Fortifying the planet with a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] generator, the Republic left a garrison force of 84 [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and 4,000 [[Republic soldier]]s led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Belth Allusis]] to protect the world which they did from a renewed Sith attack who deployed 50,000 soldiers to take the Bothan homeworld. It was only the heroic sacrifices of hundreds of Jedi Knights and Republic soldiers who fought against impossible odds. The Republic defenders were killed in the struggle, but the losses they placed on the Sith Empire forced the enemy to retreat.<ref name="timeline5" />

Bothawui was outside of Republic-controlled [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the final years of the [[New Sith Wars]], but was also beyond the borders of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] territory.<ref name="TEA" />

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Battle_of_Bothawui_TCW.png|thumb|left|200px|On his way to conquer Bothawui, Grievous got no further than the [[Golm asteroid belt|rings]] of [[Golm]].]]
In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] preceding the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Polo Se'lab]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of Bothawui, expressed desire to avoid Bothawui's involvement in the onset of open warfare.<ref name="CWCG" /> In an address directed toward [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] named Bothawui as a potential site for negotiations.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_1.html|Palpatine to Separatists: Let's Talk}}</ref> Defended by its own small planetary defense forces, Bothawui was a neutral planet during the Clone Wars and was largely untouched by the conflict, although Bothawui's neutrality did little to deter [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] and Republic representatives from attempting to recruit the world to their respective causes. However, hostile interactions between Republic and Separatist agents on Bothawui were rare.<ref name="CWCG" />

Despite its neutrality, a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]] took place in the Both system, with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attempting to invade the planet. The Republic forces on the ground were tired out after hard combat, when a fleet of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] entered the system to reinforce their own troops. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used a strategy for stopping them that saw [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] deployed on local asteroids in the [[Golm asteroid belt|rings]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Golm]], ambushing the warships from behind. The ''Munificent''{{'s}} unshielded sterns were bombarded and the battle ended with a win for the Republic.<ref name="DOAD">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref><ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Bothawui remains neutral as always, though many clans have openly sided with the Rebels, my clan has found the Imperial coffers deep enough for our loyalties. I am sure one such as you can understand.|[[Prisk Kith'Vys]], to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
The Bothans negotiated limited neutrality for Bothawui when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power and secured it position inside the Empire and enjoyed representation in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]; the world and its colonies were left relatively free from Imperial tyranny, as it didn't show any visible signs of rebellion.<ref name="FUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="SESB" /> Imperial involvement in the planet's economy was minimal, with the Empire's presence consisting mostly of a [[Imperial Consulate (Bothawui)|small consulate]] and routine patrol sweeps conducted by the sector fleet, that rarely acted beyond the routine patrol. A figure-head [[Governor/Legends|governor]]/[[Consul-General]] and a small contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was the only outward sign that the world was under supposedly Imperial governorship.<ref name="SESB" /><ref name="SOTEPG" /> The Imperial complex also consisted of an advanced communications and [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] station,<ref name="SESB" /> and agents of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who participated in a counterintelligence operation aimed toward the Bothan Spynet were stationed there. Under Imperial rule, Bothawui, though somewhat marginalized, remained a quiet and content world.<ref name="FUCG" /> 

Bothawui had no need for a prominent military force, because of its historical tradition.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> The planet showed little outward evidence of affiliation with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="SESB" /> who maintained a presence on Bothawui, operating a [[Rebel safehouse]] in the foothills surrounding [[Drev'starn]] that served as an intelligence headquarters and as an operations center for the sector.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> During the early years of the conflict, [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] Agent [[Mar Barezz]] [[Incident at Mesa 291|intercepted]] Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]] at [[Mesa 291]] on Bothawui while Tiree was recruiting support for the Rebel Alliance, but failed to capture or kill him.<ref name="Breakout" /> Both the Imperial and Rebel Alliance intelligence services apparently decided to let the planet serve as neutral ground, where they could both spy on one another with no open conflict.

[[File:Bothawui.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] on Bothawui in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].]]
Despite its neutrality, upon learning that Bothan spies had acquired the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] and given them to rogue Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]], who in turn delivered them to the Rebels, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine traveled to Bothawui with two [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards.]] The Emperor personally [[Mission to Bothawui|slaughtered]] hundreds of Bothans. Learning from one begging for his life that the plans were to arrive at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Palpatine dispatched his servant, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] to retrieve them.<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the Bothan SpyNet and its leader, [[Koth Melan]], discovered evidence revealing that the Empire was transporting a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] supposedly carrying fertilizer from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to Bothawui, which, in fact, was transporting a closely guarded [[Computer/Legends|computer]] core containing [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to a top secret Imperial construction project. Luke Skywalker, along with [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], traveled to Bothawui to aid in the capture of the plans. After that, they moved the operation to [[Kothlis]].<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

===Post-Civil War eras===
The planet was a founding member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], although long represented only indirectly by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] of Kothlis. When Fey'lya was elected [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|President]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Bothawui was again represented directly in the Senate by [[Mak Sezala]].

The [[New Republic Fourth Fleet]] made Bothawui its headquarters.<ref name="EGW" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Moxin Tark]] established contact with former agents of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on Bothawui, and as of [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], observations of this incident constituted the most recent sighting of Tark known to the New Republic.<ref name="Cracken">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> Bothawui was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj campaign]] of 7&ndash;[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], Bothawui was the subject of many anti-Bothan riots. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were caught up in one of these [[Combined Clans Center Building riot|attacks]] at a record center. Han was blamed for killing one of the rioters, though it was really an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent.<ref name="SotP" />

As the crisis escalated, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] was stationed over the planet. When he and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force had to leave, the General left [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to guard the planet's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield generator]] from anticipated subterfuge. The duo met with [[Moranda Savich]], an employee of [[Talon Karrde]], who was also attempting to stop such an attempt. The trio was only somewhat successful, as the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] team led by [[Drend Navett]] managed to bring down the shields, resulting in a [[Battle of Bothawui (Galactic Civil War)|battle at Bothawui]].<ref name="VotF" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Bothawui and the other worlds of Bothan Space were protected by the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. This kept the Fifth Fleet out of much of the actual fighting, as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] Borsk Fey'lya wanted to make sure that his home sector was safe. Still, the Bothan people served in the war in many roles, from soldiers and naval officers in the Defense Force to intelligence operatives. Their most notable contribution to the war was the famed [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]], a powerful warship that served in New Republic fleet and later the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]]. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], [[Kyp's Dozen]] moved to protect the planet following the [[Battle of Ithor]].

[[File:Bothawui_TEA.jpg|thumb|250px|Bothawui]]
The world was an important member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], though [[Ar'krai|extreme fundamentalist views]] of some Bothans in regards to the defeated [[Yuuzhan Vong]] would cause some friction. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], although originally hesitant to ally with [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] mass assassination of Bothans on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] caused them to prepare three cruiser fleets for Corellian service. The Galactic Alliance was quick to dispatch a scout screen to the planet in order to monitor the fleets. However, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]] not only persuaded intelligence chief [[Tathak K'roylan]] that the GA had conclusively been behind and backed the assassinations, but also arranged for the scout screen to be disabled. The Bothans were able to send their fleets to Corellia and there they helped break the [[Blockade of Corellia|blockade]]. Following this outbreak of hostilities, Bothawui became a founding member of the [[Confederation]]. Following the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] Bothawui rejoined the Galactic Alliance; in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Tiurrg Drey'lye]] was a senator representing the Bothan sector as well as being the head of the [[Senate Unification Preparations Committee]] for the [[Unification Summit]].

By [[137 ABY]], Bothawui was within territory controlled by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]],<ref name="TEA" /> who ordered that [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] base its operations on Bothawui and instructed his [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] to offer prestigious positions throughout the Empire to Bothans who possessed influence on Bothawui. Unrest and civil conflict arose on Bothawui as a result of Imperial indoctrination of Bothan nobles and spies.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Bothan_UAA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]].]]
Bothawui was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Bothan [[Species/Legends|species]]. Its population of 2.5 billion also included [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other species,<ref name="SOTEPG" /> who each comprised 1% of the total population.<ref name="TEA" /> Many off-worlders were drawn to Bothawui by the planet's economy and business climate.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> During the Galactic Civil War, Bothawui was a highly cosmopolitan planet, comparable to one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]; with almost every population and corporation was represented on the planet.<ref name="SESB" />

[[Bothese]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] were spoken by Bothawui's inhabitants.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
Drev'starn, the capital and largest city of Bothawui, was located in a long, broad valley near the world's equator.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> The world's primary [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was located away from the capital,<ref name="SESB" /> and the [[Tiaran'grast Sling Course|Tiaran'grast]] [[sling racing]] course was located 40 kilometers south of the capital.<ref name="SOTEPG" /> Bothans maintained a small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base, which featured 12 [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and their support crews, outside of the city.<ref name="SESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
In earlier sources, Bothawui was only known as '''Bothan's Planet''' or even as '''Bothan'''.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

In the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' Bothawui is misspelled Bothuwai several times.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Bothawui in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Sluis sector is actually located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
